name: James Halloran
summary: In Menethil Harbor, James Halloran makes a living tanning crocolisk hides. Passing travelers and nearby trade channels help him gather raw skins and carry finished leather to buyers across the eastern continents.

sections.title: A Tanner in the Marshes
sections.body: James Halloran lives and works in Menethil Harbor, earning his living from the marsh just outside town. The dangerous bogs provide crocolisk skins, which he turns into fine leather through rare craftsmanship. Nearby trade channels carry his finished goods to buyers across Azeroth.

sections.title: Hides, Apprentices, and Daily Trade
sections.body: Halloran tends his curing vats and trade arrangements near the marsh, where danger is constant. He hires hardy travelers to skin young marsh beasts and handle routine deliveries between his work site and nearby settlements. Their help keeps his leather craft supplied while he manages the tanning and trade.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a human tanner in Menethil Harbor who hunts and skins the region’s crocolisks, then cures their tough hides into leather for buyers across the world.

faq.q: Where does James Halloran sell his leather?
faq.answer: Halloran ships his fine leather throughout Azeroth. He relies on the maritime trade passing through Menethil Harbor to carry his wares across the seas.

faq.q: Why does Halloran need adventurers to collect young crocolisk skins?
faq.answer: Tanning and curing keep Halloran busy at his workshop, so he hires traveling adventurers to cull local marsh crocolisks and strip their hides. Their work gives him a steady supply of raw material without leaving his workshop.

faq.q: What is Halloran's connection to Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is Halloran’s trade and supply hub. He relies on the harbor and its shipping lanes to send cured hides to distant markets and keep his tanning business viable.

faq.q: Where can James Halloran be found?
faq.answer: James Halloran lives and works in Menethil Harbor, on the western coast of the Wetlands, with crocolisk marshes just outside town.

Yes. Halloran sent his apprentice, whom he thinks of like a son, into the marshes to skin giant crocolisks. The young man was mauled and lost a leg. While he recovers, Halloran relies on hardy travelers to gather the skins his trade needs.

angles.text: Halloran’s trade sustains the Alliance’s commercial presence in the rugged Wetlands, supplying valuable crafted leather to towns across the kingdom.
As a hunter, you may find common ground with Halloran. His livelihood depends on stalking and harvesting the Wetlands’ aggressive reptilian predators.
